subject: Interview surge routing + deputy assignments for Jordan Park (SRE lead)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interview coverage request — Jordan Park (SRE lead)

Hi team,

Heads up — candidate Jordan Park (final loop for SRE Lead) had two interviewers drop this morning due to unexpected conflicts (one OOO, one on a customer call). We need to re-route two 60-min technical interviews and a short debrief slot across tomorrow/Thursday without pushing the onsite out.

Quick ask: can one of you take the Systems Reliability deep-dive (60m)? We also need a deputy for the design/system architecture slot in case the original interviewer can't join. I've attached the candidate resume and the routing grid with current availability.

Proposed deputies: Vivek (shortlist for arch), Laura (can cover design), Rohan (can take reliability if needed). If you can confirm within the hour I’ll update the calendar and ping the candidate with the revised schedule window.

Attachments: Jordan_Park_Resume.pdf, interview-routing-grid.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview coverage request — Jordan Park (SRE lead)

Marissa — thanks for the heads up. I can take the Systems Reliability 60m if that helps. I have a 10:30–11:15 block tomorrow that I can free up and stretch to 60 if needed.

A couple of small ideas to reduce risk:
- Route the first 30m of the design interview to Laura as primary (she's happy to do 30–45m) and set me as the deputy to pick up the second half if the original interviewer gets delayed.
- For the architecture/system design slot, Vivek can be primary and Laura deputy — that keeps the senior interview coverage intact.
- If we still have missing coverage, we can apply the "on-call deputy" pattern (give one interviewer a 15m buffer before the slot starts and route to deputy automatically if they don't join by +15).

If you want, I can take end-to-end ownership of the reschedule today (update calendar invites, notify panel, and send the candidate a consolidated window). Otherwise confirm and I'll make the swaps.

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta | Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview coverage request — Jordan Park (SRE lead)

Thanks both. Rohan — please take the reliability 60m. Laura — can you be primary for the first design chunk and keep the deputy slot open? Vivek — you are primary for arch.

Marissa, please implement the +15 deputy rule for this slot and include in the calendar invite: "If the primary interviewer is >15m late, deputy will be invited to start." That avoids rescheduling the candidate.

Also: Jordan is a high-priority hire for the EU infra workstream — I'd prefer not to move beyond Thursday. If we have to extend, call out why in the update to the candidate.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Head of Infrastructure

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@gmail.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated interview schedule — Jordan Park (SRE lead)

Hi Jordan,

Quick update — we had a couple of last-minute interviewer conflicts but we were able to re-route interview coverage to keep your onsite window unchanged. Here is the updated plan for tomorrow: 

- 09:30–10:15 PDT: System Reliability deep-dive — Rohan Mehta (primary)
- 10:30–11:30 PDT: Architecture & System Design — Vivek Kulkarni (primary), Laura Bennett (deputy)
- 11:45–12:00 PDT: Hiring manager debrief — Evelyn Hart

If anything changes we'll notify you immediately; otherwise no action required on your side. Attached: candidate resume for panel.

Best,
Marissa
(Attachment: Jordan_Park_Resume.pdf)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-loop notes + quick debrief (Jordan Park)

Folks — quick debrief from the loop today: Jordan had very strong incident triage narratives and a clear POV on SLOs. Notes uploaded to the debrief doc (link below).

Action items:
- Evelyn: recommend fast-track to hiring manager debrief (since EU infra timeline is tight).
- Marissa: please run offer checklist if Evelyn gives thumbs-up; candidate has asked for a 2-week decision window.
- Laura: can you add a short note on the design trade-offs we discussed? (2–3 bullets)

Thanks for stepping in on short notice — deputy routing worked well and saved us a reschedule. I'll copy these notes into the candidate record.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-interview-debrief-template

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta | Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
(Attachment: interview-routing-grid.xlsx)
